Metadata.title: Autoservice Demontage – auto repair shop portfolio demo
Metadata.description: Autoservice Demontage is a fictional auto repair shop project that demonstrates modern frontend development with Next.js, interactive service dialogs and a demo appointment request flow.

DemoBanner.text: Portfolio demo: Autoservice Demontage is a fictional auto repair shop. No real appointments can be booked.

hero.title: Autoservice Demontage
hero.subtitle: Everything around the car. From check to repair.
hero.intro: Maintenance, repairs and vehicle diagnostics, presented as an independent auto repair shop. The business is fictional – this website shows how such a site is built.

why.heading: Why Autoservice Demontage?
why.text: Autoservice Demontage stands as an example of a down-to-earth independent garage: personal advice, transparent agreements and careful workmanship. The workshop is invented, the website behind it is not.

services.heading: Services
services.intro: Whether it's routine maintenance, a necessary repair, or tracking down the cause of a problem: we take care of your vehicle professionally and agree on the required work transparently with you.

demo.heading: How the demo works
demo.intro: Four steps, no backend at all: every entry stays in the browser and is gone on the next reload.

steps.title: Discover a service
steps.text: Pick one of the workshop services – the detail dialog shows what that service includes.

steps.title: Create a demo request
steps.text: From the dialog you go straight to the form: the service is already preselected, name, preferred date and the optional fields are added.

steps.title: Review the request
steps.text: The confirmation view summarises every entry again – held in the browser, not on a server.

steps.title: Look at the email preview
steps.text: The text a confirmation email would have carried: generated in the browser and traceable field by field.

DemoFlow.note: Every step exists for demonstration only. No real appointments are made and no confirmation emails are sent.

items: Help with maintenance, repairs and vehicle issues

dialog.cta: Fill in a demo request for {service}

items.heading: Inspection and maintenance
items.service: Regular maintenance work according to manufacturer specifications for the reliable and safe operation of your vehicle.
items.details: We service your vehicle exactly as the manufacturer specifies and check oil, filters, fluid levels, brakes, lights and electronics along the way. In advance we tell you transparently which jobs are due and what they cost. Afterwards everything is documented in your service book.

items.heading: Repairs
items.service: Professional repairs of mechanical and electrical vehicle components.
items.details: Whether it is a worn part, a leak or an electrical failure: we repair mechanical and electrical components properly. After a quick check we discuss what must be fixed right away and what can simply be monitored. Price and effort are agreed before you give the green light.

items.heading: Vehicle diagnostics
items.service: Reading out the fault memory and targeted inspection in case of warning lights, unusual noises or technical problems.
items.details: We read out the fault memory and measure systematically whenever warning lights, unusual noises or dropping performance appear. In doing so we separate the real cause from the follow-up faults it triggers. You get a clear answer on which repair actually makes sense.

items.heading: Brake service
items.service: Inspection and replacement of brake pads, brake discs and other components of the braking system.
items.details: We measure the material left on pads and discs and check the calipers, lines, handbrake and the condition of the brake fluid. What needs replacing we show you directly at the vehicle, with a transparent quote beforehand. After installation we run in the new pads.

items.heading: Oil change
items.service: Oil and filter changes tailored to your vehicle's requirements.
items.details: We change the engine oil and the oil filter in the grade your manufacturer requires and dispose of the old oil properly. While we are at it we check the fluid levels and the seals. On request we note when the next change is due.

items.heading: Tire service
items.service: Tire changes, tire condition inspection and tire pressure checks.
items.details: We mount your summer or winter tires, check tread, age and wear pattern and control the air pressure including the spare wheel. Uneven wear we trace back to the suspension or axle setting behind it. On request we balance the wheels and store your tires for the season.

items.heading: Main inspection (TÜV)
items.service: Preparing your vehicle for the main inspection and carrying out any necessary repairs by prior arrangement.
items.details: We pre-check your vehicle at the typical inspection points: brakes, lights, suspension, exhaust, fluids and visible defects. Everything else we calculate transparently in advance and fix once you approve it. That way you go into the inspection relaxed.

items.heading: Other work
items.service: Work outside this list belongs to an independent garage day to day too. In this demo you describe what you need in the notes field of the request.
items.details: The path is always the same: describe the problem, look at the vehicle, then honestly assess whether a repair is worth it. In this portfolio demo that path ends in the request form – no phone call, no email address and no real business behind it.

Impressum.title: Legal Notice
Impressum.fictionalNotice: This website shows a portfolio project. The repair shop “Autoservice Demontage” is invented; no services are offered and no appointments are made.

verantwortlich.heading: Responsible for data processing
verantwortlich.text: The controller within the meaning of the GDPR is the person who operates this website and is named in the legal notice. Requests about one’s own data are answered through the email address given there.

hosting.heading: Hosting and access data
hosting.text: This website is hosted by Vercel. When a page is requested, the hosting provider processes technical access data: the IP address, the date and time of the request, the address requested, the amount of data transferred and the type of browser. Without this data the page cannot be delivered. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; the entries are deleted once the period configured in the hosting project has passed.
hosting.anbieter: The hosting provider is Vercel Inc., based in the United States. Details on processing, retention periods and third-country transfers are given in Vercel’s privacy policy.
hosting.schriften: The fonts of this website are fetched at build time and served from the same address as the website itself. Reading a page opens no connection to a font provider.

darstellung.heading: Language and colour scheme in the browser
darstellung.sprache: Anyone who switches the language using the selection in the header or the footer has that choice stored in a cookie named NEXT_LOCALE. It holds nothing but the language code, that is de or en, it applies to the whole website, it has no expiry time and it is sent with SameSite=Lax. It can be deleted at any time in the browser settings.
darstellung.farbe: The choice between the light and the dark colour scheme is kept in the browser’s local storage under the key theme and does not leave the device. Without a personal choice the website follows the setting of the operating system.

anfrage.heading: The request form
anfrage.text: The request form is part of the demonstration: the entries stay in the browser, are not transmitted to a server, are not stored and are not sent. After reloading the page they are gone. No processing by the controller takes place in doing so.

rechte.heading: Rights
rechte.text: Anyone affected by the processing of personal data may assert these rights towards the controller:
items: Information about the data stored (Art. 15 GDPR)
Rectification of incorrect data and erasure (Art. 16 and 17 GDPR)
Objection to processing based on interests (Art. 21 GDPR)
Complaint to a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR)
